typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT [MedicaidID] 		,[Last Name] 		,[First Name] 		,[DOB] 		,[COUNTY] 		,[Tier 1/2] 		,[Reason for Case Management] 		,[Member Phone Number] 		,[LockIn (Y/N)] 		,[Pharmacy_NPI] 		,[LockIn Start Date/Last Eval Date]  FROM [DATA_EXCHANGE].[EXTRACT].[NV_TOC_421_EXTRACT]   WHERE EXCD_ID = ? ORDER BY [MedicaidID]',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		First_Name as string,
		Pharmacy_NPI as string,
		MedicaidID as string,
		Member_Phone_Number as string,
		Last_Name as string,
		LockIn_Start_Date_Last_Eval_Date as string,
		DOB as string,
		Reason_for_Case_Management as string,
		Tier_1_2 as string,
		LockIn__Y_N_ as string,
		COUNTY as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		First_Name = {First Name},
		Pharmacy_NPI,
		MedicaidID,
		Member_Phone_Number = {Member Phone Number},
		Last_Name = {Last Name},
		LockIn_Start_Date_Last_Eval_Date = {LockIn Start Date/Last Eval Date},
		DOB,
		Reason_for_Case_Management = {Reason for Case Management},
		Tier_1_2 = {Tier 1/2},
		LockIn__Y_N_ = {LockIn (Y/N)},
		COUNTY)) ~> FlatFileDestination
